references.title: K. Matomäki, M. Radziwiłł, X. Shao, T. Tao, J. Teräväinen, Singmaster's conjecture in the interior of Pascal's triangle, Quart. J. Math. 73 (2022) 1137–1177

literature_proposed.summary: Open. The residue of de Weger's conjecture after everything proved: no binomial collision C(n,k) = C(m,l) (2 ≤ k ≤ n/2, 2 ≤ l ≤ m/2, k < l) whose pair (k,l) is outside the nine solved ones, which is not of the adjacent shape (n−1,k+1), with n > 10^6 and C(n,k) > 10^60. The only general tool is Siegel's theorem, pair by pair and ineffective; a bound uniform in (k,l) is what is needed and nothing published supplies it. A proof of this hole closes the whole --h2 branch (through --h4, --h2--h1 and --h2) and, with MRSTT's Theorem 1.3 for the interior, Singmaster's conjecture.
